answer_1.quote: We introduce the task of text to complex statistical infographic generation.
answer_1.outputs: complex statistical infographics composed of multiple sub-charts with textual annotations and layout information

answer_2.quote: We introduce the following measures for evaluating the text-to-metadata generation task: (a) Sub-chart Accuracy... (b) Sub-chart Type Accuracy... (c) Statistical Accuracy... (d) Textual Information Metrics: Rouge-L scores...

answer_3.quote: we have GPT-3.5 Turbo rank them as preferred (y w ) or less preferred (y l )

answer_4.quote: A team of annotators who have knowledge of statistical infographics conducted a human evaluation on 35% of test samples randomly selected for this purpose.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation metrics used: Readability Score, were provided to assess the clarity, organization, and flow of the generated infographic; Visual Score, which evaluated the layout, design, colors and subchart identification with respect to ground truth; and Data Accuracy and Subchart Alignment Score, measuring the correctness of the data and the alignment of the sub-charts with respect to each other in the statistical infographic in effectively conveying key insights.
